title: Vehicle Crash Severity Prediction
summary: A data science project analyzing vehicle crash data to predict crash severity (minor injury, major injury, fatal) using classifiers like XGBoost, CatBoost, and Random Forest. The notebook also uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer via sdv.single_table to generate synthetic crash data for data augmentation.
